text: The author employs an alternating first-person point of view, allowing the narrative to shift between the perspectives of different members of a space expedition team. This technique highlights the contrasting personalities within the group, specifically moving from the optimistic and curious voice of the scientist to the pragmatic and cautious voice of the engineer. The tone is similarly dynamic, blending technical language when describing machinery and phenomena with a more reflective and philosophical mood when the characters contemplate their existence in the universe.
